title: 1997 service manual cross-check
scope: Documented vehicle wiring and behavior, compared with the reference image. This manual does not identify the exact calibration in the dump.

pins.function: Malfunction indicator lamp driver (see lamp-path caveat)
LEFT upstream oxygen signal; wiring diagram resolves table label error

findings.title: The key-turn display is documented here
findings.manual: ON, OFF, ON, OFF, ON within five seconds starts the two-digit trouble-code display. Short pauses separate digits; longer pauses separate codes. Code 12 concerns a recent battery disconnect; 55 ends the display.
findings.rom: The recovered serializer and three-event arming path agree with this feature. The complete route from the physical key through the companion electronics is still untraced.

findings.title: Reverse: power releases the restriction
findings.manual: Below 5 mph, the PCM grounds K136 at C2-21, energizing the solenoid and allowing reverse. Above 5 mph it releases the ground, and reverse is restricted. The solenoid receives ignition power on F12.
findings.rom: The comparison is strictly greater than 06. Truncation makes raw 07 / filtered word 224 the first set state, nominally 3.5 mph. The shared-port handoff is traced; the manual carries C2-21 through C111-3 and C330-6 to solenoid B. The PCB driver/inversion and reason for the manual's 5 mph specification remain unresolved.

findings.title: Skip shift uses a separate solenoid and lamp
findings.manual: K33 at C1-6 controls the solenoid that blocks second and third gear. G54 at C2-11 controls the upshift lamp. The manual describes a warm engine, light throttle, first gear and 12-18 mph, with reset below 2 mph.
findings.rom: This image has minimum coolant byte FE at ROM 3DA1, nominally 190 C, so ordinary coolant readings fail the normal entry gate. The manual describes stock vehicle behavior; its warm-engine threshold cannot replace this dump's actual value.

findings.title: Ten injectors and five ignition coils
findings.manual: All ten injector drivers are on C2; five coil drivers are on C3. The injectors operate sequentially. Each coil fires two spark plugs together, with one cylinder on compression and the other on exhaust.
findings.rom: This fits the selected ten-cylinder profile and its five paired-cylinder masks. Matching each recovered command or timer channel to an individual harness pin still needs a hardware trace.

findings.title: Four oxygen sensors are shown in the wiring
findings.manual: There is an upstream and downstream oxygen sensor on each side. The upstream diagram assigns C3-24 to LEFT and C3-26 to RIGHT. The downstream circuit names change with coupe versus roadster, while right stays C3-25 and left stays C3-29.
findings.rom: Four physical sensors do not mean every shared monitor is enabled in this image. Rear-feedback configuration gates remain disabled in the reference bytes. The RAM-channel-to-harness mapping is still provisional.

findings.title: ASD and fuel-pump relays have different controls
findings.manual: C1-3 / K51 grounds the ASD relay coil; C1-19 / K31 grounds the fuel-pump relay coil. ASD output A142 supplies engine loads and returns to C1-12 as a sense input.
findings.rom: The named diagnostic requests support following the software roles. They do not establish that a request bit is itself a continuously driven relay output.

caveats.title: A repeated upstream label is a table error
caveats.body: The C3 table calls both cavities 24 and 26 right upstream. Diagram 8W-30-13 explicitly routes LEFT upstream K241 to cavity 24 and RIGHT upstream K41 to cavity 26. The table above follows that diagram and flags the correction.

caveats.title: Duplicate downstream rows are body-style alternatives
caveats.body: The footnotes on 8W-80-35 mean one asterisk = coupe, two = roadster. K141 is TN/WT; K341 is PK/WT. Diagram 8W-30-14 confirms these alternatives. They are not extra pins or extra oxygen sensors.

caveats.title: The skip-shift prose disagrees with itself
caveats.body: Page 14-29 prints 608 RPM; 21-2 prints 600 RPM. Page 14-29 gives 0.68 V above closed throttle for the lamp but 0.068 V for the solenoid, both described as 23 percent. Keep these printed values separate from the actual recovered calibration; they are not a reliable conversion rule.

caveats.title: The lamp path still needs tracing
caveats.body: The connector table lists C1-17 / G3 as a malfunction-lamp driver. Pages 14-28 and 25-1 also describe a CCD message to the instrument cluster. This does not establish the serializer's final physical output route or timing.

caveats.title: Connector names vary between sections
caveats.body: The circuit prose uses A, B and C cavity prefixes that align with black C3, white C2 and gray C1 in these pin tables. For example B21 matches C2-21 and C6 matches C1-6. Read connector and cavity together; the prose label C3 for ASD is not black connector C3 pin 3.
